blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine government’s outstanding debt rose to a record P19.61 trillion in August, nearing its full-year target as continued borrowing and the weaker peso drove the increase. On Wednesday, the Bureau of Treasury said total outstanding debt rose 1.12 percent from the previous month. READ: PH debt levels remain sustainable — DOF The debt pile has grown 10.72 percent, or nearly P1.9 trillion, since the start of the year. August’s total was equivalent to 99 percent of the government’s P19.77-trillion year-end target for 2026, underscoring the fast pace of borrowing as the administration seeks to finance its budget […]...
